capabilities: Set task status from a right-click menu
Use Tasks plugin statuses and settings
Create the next recurring task occurrence
extras: Works on phones and tablets via long-press; the author also publishes Right-Click Tag Colors.
intentEvidence: a Task status submenu is added to Obsidian's own right-click menu
problem: Changing a task's status normally requires typing symbols between brackets and remembering which character means what.

relations.evidence: this plugin works through it, so a status change behaves exactly like it does in Tasks

summary: Right-click context menu plugin that sets a task's status, working through the Tasks plugin or its own editable status list.
